definitions.name: IKEA STYRBAR
definitions.svg:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!--
  IKEA STYRBAR remote — front-on trace from the product photo.
  A squarish paddle with rounded corners. Four flat-panel button zones:
    Top:    ON  — sun-with-rays in a circular indent
    Bottom: OFF — smaller dimmer-sun in a circular indent
    Left:   "<" chevron
    Right:  ">" chevron
-->
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     viewBox="0 0 280 280"
     role="img"
     aria-label="IKEA STYRBAR remote">
  <style>
    .rs-button { cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease-in-out; }
    .rs-button:hover .btn-shape { fill: #ebe6dc; }
    .rs-button.is-active .btn-shape {
      fill: var(--rs-btn-active-fill, #d8e8ff);
      stroke: var(--rs-btn-active-stroke, #5b8def);
    }
    .rs-button.is-pulsing .btn-shape {
      fill: var(--rs-btn-pulse-fill, #ffd66e);
      transition: fill 80ms ease-out;
    }
    .icon { fill: none; stroke: #6e6859; stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; pointer-events: none; }
    .indent {
      fill: none;
      stroke: #cfc8bc;
      stroke-width: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Body: squircle (continuous-curvature rounded square). Each side
       is one cubic bezier — control points are pulled close to the
       corner so the sides read flat-ish in the middle and the
       corners blend smoothly without a visible "circle starts here"
       inflection. Matches the soft pebble feel of the real STYRBAR. -->
  <path
    d="M 140 20
       C 230 20 260 50 260 140
       C 260 230 230 260 140 260
       C 50 260 20 230 20 140
       C 20 50 50 20 140 20
       Z"
    fill="#fafaf6" stroke="#7a7363" stroke-width="1.4" />

  <!-- ======== TOP: ON button (sun with rays) ======== -->
  <g id="button-on" class="rs-button">
    <!-- Hit area covers the upper third -->
    <rect class="btn-shape" x="20" y="20" width="240" height="100"
          rx="40" ry="40" fill="transparent" />
    <!-- Circular indent around the icon -->
    <circle class="indent" cx="140" cy="65" r="22" />
    <!-- Sun with rays (the "ON" icon) -->
    <g transform="translate(140, 65)">
      <circle class="icon" r="7" />
      <line class="icon" x1="0"   y1="-12" x2="0"   y2="-17" />
      <line class="icon" x1="12"  y1="0"   x2="17"  y2="0" />
      <line class="icon" x1="0"   y1="12"  x2="0"   y2="17" />
      <line class="icon" x1="-12" y1="0"   x2="-17" y2="0" />
      <line class="icon" x1="9"   y1="-9"  x2="13"  y2="-13" />
      <line class="icon" x1="9"   y1="9"   x2="13"  y2="13" />
      <line class="icon" x1="-9"  y1="9"   x2="-13" y2="13" />
      <line class="icon" x1="-9"  y1="-9"  x2="-13" y2="-13" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ======== BOTTOM: OFF button (smaller dimmer sun) ======== -->
  <g id="button-off" class="rs-button">
    <rect class="btn-shape" x="20" y="180" width="240" height="80"
          rx="40" ry="40" fill="transparent" />
    <circle class="indent" cx="140" cy="220" r="20" />
    <g transform="translate(140, 220)">
      <circle class="icon" r="6" />
      <line class="icon" x1="0"   y1="-9"  x2="0"   y2="-11" />
      <line class="icon" x1="9"   y1="0"   x2="11"  y2="0" />
      <line class="icon" x1="0"   y1="9"   x2="0"   y2="11" />
      <line class="icon" x1="-9"  y1="0"   x2="-11" y2="0" />
      <line class="icon" x1="6.4" y1="-6.4" x2="7.8" y2="-7.8" />
      <line class="icon" x1="6.4" y1="6.4"  x2="7.8" y2="7.8" />
      <line class="icon" x1="-6.4" y1="6.4" x2="-7.8" y2="7.8" />
      <line class="icon" x1="-6.4" y1="-6.4" x2="-7.8" y2="-7.8" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ======== LEFT: "<" chevron ======== -->
  <g id="button-arrow_left" class="rs-button">
    <rect class="btn-shape" x="20" y="100" width="80" height="80"
          fill="transparent" />
    <polyline class="icon" points="58,128 44,140 58,152" />
  </g>

  <!-- ======== RIGHT: ">" chevron ======== -->
  <g id="button-arrow_right" class="rs-button">
    <rect class="btn-shape" x="180" y="100" width="80" height="80"
          fill="transparent" />
    <polyline class="icon" points="222,128 236,140 222,152" />
  </g>
</svg>

definitions.name: IKEA BILRESA (scroll wheel)
definitions.svg:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!--
  IKEA BILRESA scroll wheel — straight-on trace from product photos.
    Body W:H ≈ 1 : 1.4 (160 × 224 in this viewBox).
    Wheel diameter ≈ 87% of body width (close to the silhouette edges
    on left & right, like the photos).
    Wheel sits high on the body, dots cluster just below it.
-->
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     viewBox="0 0 200 264"
     role="img"
     aria-label="IKEA BILRESA scroll wheel">
  <style>
    .rs-button { cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease-in-out; }
    .rs-button:hover circle.dot { fill: #5b554a; }
    .rs-button.is-active circle.dot {
      fill: var(--rs-btn-active-stroke, #5b8def);
    }
    .rs-button.is-pulsing circle.dot {
      fill: var(--rs-btn-pulse-fill, #ffd66e);
      transition: fill 80ms ease-out;
    }

    .rs-wheel { transform-origin: 100px 92px; transition: transform 280ms ease-out; }
    .rs-wheel.is-pulsing { animation: rs-wheel-pulse 480ms ease-out 1; }
    @keyframes rs-wheel-pulse {
      0%   { transform: scale(1); }
      30%  { transform: scale(1.03); }
      100% { transform: scale(1); }
    }

    .dot { fill: #b8b1a0; }
  </style>

  <!-- Body silhouette: vertical pill, fully rounded ends, cream fill. -->
  <path d="M 20 100
           A 80 80 0 0 1 180 100
           L 180 164
           A 80 80 0 0 1 20 164
           Z"
        fill="#efeadd"
        stroke="#7a7363"
        stroke-width="1.4"
        stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <!-- Wheel disc — slightly lighter than the body. -->
  <g class="rs-wheel" id="wheel">
    <circle cx="100" cy="92" r="69"
            fill="#f7f3e9" stroke="#7a7363" stroke-width="1.2" />
  </g>

  <!-- Three indicator dots, centered just below the wheel. -->
  <g id="button-dot1" class="rs-button">
    <circle cx="93" cy="180" r="10" fill="transparent" />
    <circle class="dot" cx="93" cy="180" r="1.8" />
  </g>
  <g id="button-dot2" class="rs-button">
    <circle cx="100" cy="180" r="10" fill="transparent" />
    <circle class="dot" cx="100" cy="180" r="1.8" />
  </g>
  <g id="button-dot3" class="rs-button">
    <circle cx="107" cy="180" r="10" fill="transparent" />
    <circle class="dot" cx="107" cy="180" r="1.8" />
  </g>
</svg>
